## 1. Design System Foundation

### Breakpoints (Tailwind Defaults)

```
sm: 640px   - Mobile landscape
md: 768px   - Tablet portrait
lg: 1024px  - Tablet landscape / Small desktop
xl: 1280px  - Desktop
2xl: 1536px - Large desktop
```

### Color Tokens (CSS Variables)

**CRITICAL: Tailwind CSS v4 Syntax**

```css
/* client/src/index.css - CORRECT v4 syntax */
@import "tailwindcss";

@layer base {
  :root {
    --background: 0 0% 100%;
    --foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --card: 0 0% 100%;
    --card-foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --popover: 0 0% 100%;
    --popover-foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --primary: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%;
    --primary-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --secondary: 210 40% 96.1%;
    --secondary-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%;
    --muted: 210 40% 96.1%;
    --muted-foreground: 215.4 16.3% 46.9%;
    --accent: 210 40% 96.1%;
    --accent-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%;
    --destructive: 0 84.2% 60.2%;
    --destructive-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --border: 214.3 31.8% 91.4%;
    --input: 214.3 31.8% 91.4%;
    --ring: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    
    /* Foundry Brand Colors */
    --success: 142 76% 36%;
    --success-foreground: 355 100% 97%;
    --warning: 38 92% 50%;
    --warning-foreground: 48 96% 89%;
    --info: 199 89% 48%;
    --info-foreground: 199 100% 97%;
  }

  .dark {
    --background: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --card: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --card-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --popover: 222.2 84% 4.9%;
    --popover-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --primary: 210 40% 98%;
    --primary-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%;
    --secondary: 217.2 32.6% 17.5%;
    --secondary-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --muted: 217.2 32.6% 17.5%;
    --muted-foreground: 215 20.2% 65.1%;
    --accent: 217.2 32.6% 17.5%;
    --accent-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --destructive: 0 62.8% 30.6%;
    --destructive-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
    --border: 217.2 32.6% 17.5%;
    --input: 217.2 32.6% 17.5%;
    --ring: 212.7 26.8% 83.9%;
    
    --success: 142 70% 45%;
    --warning: 38 92% 50%;
    --info: 199 89% 48%;
  }
}

@layer base {
  * {
    @apply border-border;
  }
  body {
    @apply bg-background text-foreground;
  }
}
```

### Typography Scale

| Level | Class | Size | Weight |
|-------|-------|------|--------|
| H1 | text-4xl font-bold | 36px | 700 |
| H2 | text-3xl font-semibold | 30px | 600 |
| H3 | text-2xl font-semibold | 24px | 600 |
| H4 | text-xl font-medium | 20px | 500 |
| Body | text-base | 16px | 400 |
| Small | text-sm | 14px | 400 |
| XS | text-xs | 12px | 400 |

### Spacing Scale (Tailwind)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| 0.5 | 2px | Tight spacing |
| 1 | 4px | Icon padding |
| 2 | 8px | Inline elements |
| 3 | 12px | Form field padding |
| 4 | 16px | Card padding |
| 6 | 24px | Section spacing |
| 8 | 32px | Large gaps |
| 12 | 48px | Page sections |
| 16 | 64px | Page margins |

### Border Radius

| Class | Value |
|-------|-------|
| rounded-sm | calc(var(--radius) - 4px) |
| rounded-md | calc(var(--radius) - 2px) |
| rounded-lg | var(--radius) |
| rounded-xl | calc(var(--radius) + 4px) |

### Accessibility Requirements

- **Target:** WCAG 2.1 AA minimum
- **Color Contrast:** 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
- **Focus Indicators:** ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements
- **Keyboard Navigation:** Full support via Radix primitives
- **Touch Targets:** Minimum 44x44px for mobile
- **Screen Reader:** ARIA labels on all icon buttons

## 2. Component Library

### shadcn/ui Components Required

```bash
npx shadcn-ui@latest init
npx shadcn-ui@latest add button card dialog form input label select toast alert alert-dialog dropdown-menu avatar badge skeleton tabs table progress switch checkbox textarea separator sheet command popover tooltip
```

### Peer Dependencies

```bash
npm install @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog @radix-ui/react-dialog @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu @radix-ui/react-label @radix-ui/react-select @radix-ui/react-slot @radix-ui/react-tabs @radix-ui/react-toast @radix-ui/react-progress @radix-ui/react-switch @radix-ui/react-checkbox @radix-ui/react-popover @radix-ui/react-tooltip
npm install lucide-react class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge
npm install react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod
npm install @tanstack/react-query
npm install react-dropzone
```

### Custom Components

#### PageHeader Component

```tsx
interface PageHeaderProps {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
}

<div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
  <div>
    <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
    {description && (
      <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{description}</p>
    )}
  </div>
  {action && <div>{action}</div>}
</div>
```

```tsx

}

</Card>
```

#### FileUploader Component

```tsx
interface FileUploaderProps {
```

#### ProcessingProgress Component

```tsx
interface ProcessingProgressProps {
  stage: 'fetching' | 'processing' | 'deidentifying' | 'formatting' | 'complete';
  progress: number;
  recordsProcessed: number;
  totalRecords: number;
}

const stages = [
  { key: 'fetching', label: 'Fetching Data' },
  { key: 'processing', label: 'Processing' },
  { key: 'deidentifying', label: 'De-identifying' },
  { key: 'formatting', label: 'Formatting Output' },
];

<Card>
  <CardContent className="p-6">
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {stages.map((s, i) => (
        <div key={s.key} className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {/* Stage indicator */}
        </div>
      ))}
      <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center">
        {recordsProcessed.toLocaleString()} / {totalRecords.toLocaleString()} records
      </p>
    </div>
  </CardContent>
</Card>
```

## 3. Navigation Structure

### Primary Navigation (Sidebar)

| Label | Route | Icon | Roles | Description |
|-------|-------|------|-------|-------------|
| Dashboard | /dashboard | LayoutDashboard | member, admin | Overview and recent activity |
| Projects | /projects | FolderKanban | member, admin | Project listing |
| Activity | /activity | Activity | member, admin | Activity log |
| Settings | /settings | Settings | member, admin | User and org settings |

### Settings Sub-Navigation

| Label | Route | Roles |
|-------|-------|-------|
| Profile | /settings/profile | member, admin |
| Team | /settings/team | admin |
| Organization | /settings/organization | admin |

### Project Sub-Navigation (Tabs)

| Label | Route | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Overview | /projects/:id | Project dashboard |
| Sources | /projects/:id/sources | Data sources |
| Mapping | /projects/:id/mapping | Field mapping |
| Privacy | /projects/:id/privacy | De-identification rules |
| Filters | /projects/:id/filters | Quality filters |
| Processing | /projects/:id/processing | Run processing |
| Exports | /projects/:id/exports | Download outputs |

### User Menu (Dropdown)

| Label | Action | Roles |
|-------|--------|-------|
| Profile | Navigate to /settings/profile | all |
| Log out | Call logout API, clear token, redirect to /login | all |

### Role-Based Navigation Gating

```tsx
// client/src/lib/navigation.ts
export const mainNavItems = [
  { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, roles: ['member', 'admin'] },
  { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects', icon: FolderKanban, roles: ['member', 'admin'] },
  { label: 'Activity', href: '/activity', icon: Activity, roles: ['member', 'admin'] },
  { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings', icon: Settings, roles: ['member', 'admin'] },
];

export const settingsNavItems = [
  { label: 'Profile', href: '/settings/profile', roles: ['member', 'admin'] },
  { label: 'Team', href: '/settings/team', roles: ['admin'] },
  { label: 'Organization', href: '/settings/organization', roles: ['admin'] },
];

// Usage in Sidebar component
const user = useAuth();
const visibleItems = mainNavItems.filter(item => item.roles.includes(user.role));
```

## 4. Screen Specifications

### 4.1 Auth Screens

#### Login Page

**Route:** /login  
**Roles:** Public  
**User Stories:** US-AUTH-002

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50">
  <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
    <CardHeader className="text-center">
      <Logo className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-4" />
      <CardTitle>Welcome to Foundry</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>Sign in to your account</CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent>
      <LoginForm />
    </CardContent>
    <CardFooter className="flex-col space-y-2">
      <Button variant="link" asChild>
        <Link to="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</Link>
      </Button>
    </CardFooter>
  </Card>
</div>
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Default | Form with email/password fields, Sign In button |
| Submitting | Button shows spinner, fields disabled |
| Error (Invalid credentials) | Toast destructive: "Invalid email or password" |
| Error (Rate limited) | Toast with countdown: "Too many attempts. Try again in X seconds" |
| Success | Redirect to /dashboard |

---

#### Register Page (Accept Invitation)

**Route:** /register/:token  
**Roles:** Public  
**User Stories:** US-AUTH-001

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data: invitation, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['invitation', token],
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/invitations/${token}/validate`)
});
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Loading | Skeleton card with "Validating invitation..." |
| Invalid Token | Alert destructive: "This invitation link is invalid or has expired" with link to contact admin |
| Expired Token | Alert warning: "This invitation has expired. Please request a new invitation." |
| Already Used | Alert info: "This invitation has already been used." with link to login |
| Valid | Registration form showing invited email (read-only), name field, password field |
| Submitting | Button shows spinner |
| Success | Toast success, redirect to /dashboard |

---

#### Forgot Password Page

**Route:** /forgot-password  
**Roles:** Public  
**User Stories:** US-AUTH-004

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Default | Email input field, Submit button |
| Submitting | Button shows spinner |
| Success | Alert success: "If an account exists, we've sent reset instructions" |
| Rate Limited | Toast with countdown |

---

#### Reset Password Page

**Route:** /reset-password/:token  
**Roles:** Public  
**User Stories:** US-AUTH-004

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Loading | Validating token spinner |
| Invalid Token | Alert destructive with link to forgot-password |
| Expired Token | Alert warning: "This link has expired" with link to request new |
| Valid | New password and confirm password fields |
| Success | Toast success, redirect to /login |

### 4.2 Dashboard

#### Dashboard Page

**Route:** /dashboard  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-PROJ-002

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data: projects } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.list({ limit: 5 }),
  queryFn: () => api.get('/api/projects?limit=5')
});

const { data: activity } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.activity.recent(),
  queryFn: () => api.get('/api/activity?limit=10')
});
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
  <PageHeader
    title="Dashboard"
    description="Overview of your data processing projects"
  />
  
  {/* Stats Row */}
  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
    <DataCard title="Total Projects" value={stats.projects} icon={FolderKanban} />
    <DataCard title="Data Sources" value={stats.sources} icon={Database} />
    <DataCard title="Records Processed" value={stats.records} icon={FileText} />
    <DataCard title="Active Processing" value={stats.active} icon={Loader2} />
  </div>
  
  {/* Two Column Layout */}
  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
    {/* Recent Projects */}
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Recent Projects</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ProjectList projects={projects} />
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter>
        <Button variant="link" asChild>
          <Link to="/projects">View all projects</Link>
        </Button>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
    
    {/* Recent Activity */}
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Recent Activity</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <ActivityFeed activities={activity} />
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </div>
</div>
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Loading | Skeleton cards for stats, skeleton list items |
| Default | Stats, project list, activity feed |
| Empty (No projects) | Empty state with "Create your first project" CTA |
| Error | Alert with retry button |

### 4.3 Projects

#### Projects List Page

**Route:** /projects  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-PROJ-002

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.list({ page, limit: 20 }),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects?page=${page}&limit=20`)
});
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
  <PageHeader
    title="Projects"
    description="Manage your data processing projects"
    action={
      <Button asChild>
        <Link to="/projects/new">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          New Project
        </Link>
      </Button>
    }
  />
  
  {/* Projects Grid */}
  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
    {projects.map(project => (
      <ProjectCard key={project.id} project={project} />
    ))}
  </div>
  
  {/* Pagination */}
  <Pagination {...pagination} />
</div>
```

**Project Card:**
```tsx
<Card className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/projects/${project.id}`)}>
  <CardHeader>
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
      <div>
        <CardTitle className="text-lg">{project.name}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="line-clamp-2">{project.description}</CardDescription>
      </div>
      <Badge variant={project.status === 'processing' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>
        {project.status}
      </Badge>
    </div>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <Database className="h-4 w-4" />
        {project.sourceCount} sources
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <Clock className="h-4 w-4" />
        {formatRelativeTime(project.updatedAt)}
      </div>
    </div>
  </CardContent>
</Card>
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Loading | Grid of skeleton cards |
| Default | Grid of project cards |
| Empty | Empty state: "No projects yet", "Create your first project" CTA |
| Error | Alert destructive with retry button |

#### Project Detail Page

**Route:** /projects/:id  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-PROJ-002, US-PROC-002

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data: project, isLoading } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.detail(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}`)
});

const { data: processingStatus } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.processing(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/processing`),
  refetchInterval: project?.status === 'processing' ? 2000 : false
});
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
  {/* Project Header */}
  <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" asChild>
          <Link to="/projects"><ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /></Link>
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold">{project.name}</h1>
      </div>
      <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{project.description}</p>
    </div>
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditDialogOpen(true)}>
        <Edit className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
        Edit
      </Button>
      {user.role === 'admin' && (
        <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => setDeleteDialogOpen(true)}>
          <Trash className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Delete
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  </div>
  
  {/* Project Tabs */}
  <Tabs value={activeTab} onValueChange={setActiveTab}>
    <TabsList>
      <TabsTrigger value="overview">Overview</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="sources">Sources</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="mapping">Mapping</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="privacy">Privacy</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="filters">Filters</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="processing">Processing</TabsTrigger>
      <TabsTrigger value="exports">Exports</TabsTrigger>
    </TabsList>
    
    <TabsContent value="overview">
      <ProjectOverviewTab project={project} status={processingStatus} />
    </TabsContent>
    {/* ... other tabs */}
  </Tabs>
</div>
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Loading | Skeleton header + tabs |
| Default | Project header with tabs |
| Not Found | 404 page with back to projects link |
| Processing Active | Processing tab shows live progress |

### 4.4 Sources

#### Project Sources Tab

**Route:** /projects/:id/sources  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-FILE-001, US-FILE-004, US-API-001

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="space-y-6">
  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
    <div>
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Data Sources</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Add files or connect APIs to import data
      </p>
    </div>
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button>
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Add Source
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => setFileUploadOpen(true)}>
          <Upload className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Upload File
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => setApiConnectOpen(true)}>
          <Plug className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Connect Teamwork Desk
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  </div>
  
  {/* Sources List */}
  {sources.length === 0 ? (
    <EmptyState
      icon={Database}
      title="No data sources"
      description="Upload a file or connect an API to get started"
      action={{ label: "Add Source", onClick: () => setFileUploadOpen(true) }}
    />
  ) : (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {sources.map(source => (
        <SourceCard key={source.id} source={source} onPreview={() => setPreviewSource(source)} />
      ))}
    </div>
  )}
</div>
```

**Source Card:**
```tsx
<Card>
  <CardContent className="p-4">
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
          {source.type === 'file' ? (
            <FileText className="h-5 w-5" />

            <Plug className="h-5 w-5" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="font-medium">{source.name}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {source.type === 'file' ? source.fileType.toUpperCase() : 'Teamwork Desk'} •
            {source.recordCount.toLocaleString()} records •
            {source.columnCount} fields
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => onPreview()}>
          <Eye className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Preview
        </Button>
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon">

          </DropdownMenuTrigger>

              <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onRefresh()}>
                <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Refresh Data
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            )}
            <DropdownMenuItem className="text-destructive" onClick={() => onDelete()}>
              <Trash className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              Delete
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>
    </div>
  </CardContent>
</Card>
```

#### File Upload Dialog

**User Stories:** US-FILE-001, US-FILE-002, US-FILE-003

**Layout:**
```tsx
<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Upload File</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>
        Upload a CSV, Excel, or JSON file (max 50MB)
      </DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    
    <FileUploader
      accept={{
        'text/csv': ['.csv'],
        'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet': ['.xlsx'],
        'application/vnd.ms-excel': ['.xls'],
        'application/json': ['.json']
      }}
      maxSize={50 * 1024 * 1024}
      onUpload={handleUpload}
      isLoading={isUploading}
    />
    
    {selectedFile && (
      <div className="p-4 bg-muted rounded-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="font-medium">{selectedFile.name}</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {formatFileSize(selectedFile.size)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    )}
    
    {/* Excel Sheet Selector (shown for Excel files) */}
    {fileType === 'excel' && sheets.length > 0 && (
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <Label>Select Sheet</Label>
        <Select value={selectedSheet} onValueChange={setSelectedSheet}>
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue placeholder="Choose a sheet" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {sheets.map(sheet => (
              <SelectItem key={sheet} value={sheet}>{sheet}</SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>
    )}
    
    <DialogFooter>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={!selectedFile || isUploading}>
        {isUploading ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
        Upload
      </Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

**States:**

| State | Appearance |
|-------|------------|
| Default | Dropzone with instructions |
| Dragging | Dropzone highlighted |
| File Selected | File info shown, Upload button enabled |
| Excel Selected | Sheet selector shown |
| Uploading | Progress bar, Upload button disabled with spinner |
| Upload Error | Toast destructive with specific error |
| Success | Toast success, dialog closes |

#### Teamwork Desk Connection Dialog

**User Stories:** US-API-001, US-API-002

**Layout:**
```tsx
<Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Connect Teamwork Desk</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>
        Enter your Teamwork Desk credentials to import support tickets
      </DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    
    <Form {...form}>
      <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="domain"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Teamwork Domain</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <div className="flex">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3 rounded-l-md border border-r-0 border-input bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    https://
                  </span>
                  <Input {...field} placeholder="yourcompany" className="rounded-l-none" />
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3 rounded-r-md border border-l-0 border-input bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    .teamwork.com
                  </span>
                </div>
              </FormControl>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="apiKey"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>API Key</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} type="password" placeholder="Your Teamwork API key" />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>
                Find this in Teamwork Settings → Integrations → API & Webhooks
              </FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          onClick={testConnection}
          disabled={isTestingConnection}
        >
          {isTestingConnection ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
          Test Connection
        </Button>
        
        {connectionStatus === 'success' && (
          <>
            <Alert>
              <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>Connection successful!</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
            
            {/* Inbox Selection */}
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="inboxId"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Inbox</FormLabel>
                  <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select an inbox" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {inboxes.map(inbox => (
                        <SelectItem key={inbox.id} value={String(inbox.id)}>
                          {inbox.name}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            
            {/* Date Range Filter */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="dateFrom"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>From Date</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input {...field} type="date" />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="dateTo"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>To Date</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input {...field} type="date" />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        
        {connectionStatus === 'error' && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>{connectionError}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={connectionStatus !== 'success' || isSubmitting}>
            {isSubmitting ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
            Connect
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </form>
    </Form>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
```

### 4.5 Field Mapping

#### Project Mapping Tab

**Route:** /projects/:id/mapping  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-MAP-001, US-MAP-002, US-MAP-003

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data: mapping } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.mapping(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/mapping`)
});

const { data: sources } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.sources(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/sources`)
});
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="space-y-6">
  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
    <div>
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Field Mapping</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Map source fields to training data structure
      </p>
    </div>
    <Button onClick={autoDetect} disabled={isAutoDetecting}>
      {isAutoDetecting ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : <Wand2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />}
      Auto-detect
    </Button>
  </div>
  
  {sources.length === 0 ? (
    <Alert>
      <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
      <AlertDescription>
        Add at least one data source before configuring field mappings.
      </AlertDescription>
    </Alert>
  ) : (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="p-0">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead className="w-[200px]">Target Field</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Source Field</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Required</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {targetFields.map(field => (
              <TableRow key={field.name}>
                <TableCell>
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium">{field.label}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{field.description}</p>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Select
                    value={mapping[field.name]}
                    onValueChange={(v) => updateMapping(field.name, v)}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue placeholder="Select source field" />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="">-- Not mapped --</SelectItem>
                      {sourceFields.map(sf => (
                        <SelectItem key={sf} value={sf}>{sf}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {field.required ? (
                    <Badge variant="destructive">Required</Badge>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant="secondary">Optional</Badge>
                  )}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  )}
  
  {/* Role Assignment Section */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Role Assignment</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>
        How to identify agent vs customer messages
      </CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="space-y-4">
      <FormField
        control={form.control}
        name="roleField"
        render={({ field }) => (
          <FormItem>
            <FormLabel>Role Field</FormLabel>
            <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select field containing role" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {sourceFields.map(sf => (
                  <SelectItem key={sf} value={sf}>{sf}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <FormMessage />
          </FormItem>
        )}
      />
      
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="agentValue"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Agent Value</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} placeholder="e.g., agent, support" />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>Value that identifies agent messages</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="customerValue"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Customer Value</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} placeholder="e.g., customer, user" />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>Value that identifies customer messages</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </div>
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
  
  <div className="flex justify-end">
    <Button onClick={saveMapping} disabled={isSaving || !hasChanges}>
      {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />}
      Save Mapping
    </Button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### 4.6 De-identification (Privacy)

#### Project Privacy Tab

**Route:** /projects/:id/privacy  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-PII-001, US-PII-002, US-PII-003, US-PII-004

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="space-y-6">
  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
    <div>
      <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Privacy & De-identification</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Configure PII detection and replacement rules
      </p>
    </div>
    <Button onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(true)}>
      <Eye className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
      Preview
    </Button>
  </div>
  
  {/* Built-in PII Types */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle className="text-lg">PII Detection</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>
        Enable detection for common personal information types
      </CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="space-y-4">
      {piiTypes.map(type => (
        <div key={type.key} className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <type.icon className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-medium">{type.label}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{type.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Switch
            checked={config[type.key]}
            onCheckedChange={(checked) => updateConfig(type.key, checked)}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
  
  {/* Custom Patterns */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Custom Patterns</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Add regex patterns to detect company-specific identifiers
          </CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setAddPatternOpen(true)}>
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
          Add Pattern
        </Button>
      </div>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent>
      {customPatterns.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
          No custom patterns configured
        </p>
      ) : (
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Pattern</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Replacement</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {customPatterns.map(pattern => (
              <TableRow key={pattern.id}>
                <TableCell>{pattern.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <code className="text-xs bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded">{pattern.regex}</code>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{pattern.replacement}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => editPattern(pattern)}>
                      <Edit className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => deletePattern(pattern.id)}>
                      <Trash className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      )}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
  
  <div className="flex justify-end">
    <Button onClick={saveConfig} disabled={isSaving || !hasChanges}>
      {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />}
      Save Configuration
    </Button>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="space-y-6">
  <div>
    <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Quality Filters</h2>
    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Filter data by quality criteria to improve training dataset
    </p>
  </div>
  
  {/* Filter Stats */}
  {filterStats && (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="pt-6">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
          <div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{filterStats.total.toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Total Records</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-destructive">{filterStats.filtered.toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Filtered Out</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-success">{filterStats.remaining.toLocaleString()}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Remaining</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Progress value={(filterStats.remaining / filterStats.total) * 100} className="mt-4" />
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  )}
  
  {/* Message Count Filter */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Conversation Length</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Filter by number of messages</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={filters.messageCount.enabled}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => updateFilter('messageCount', 'enabled', v)}
        />
      </div>
    </CardHeader>
    {filters.messageCount.enabled && (
      <CardContent>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="messageCount.min"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Minimum Messages</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} type="number" min={1} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>Exclude conversations with fewer messages</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </CardContent>
    )}
  </Card>
  
  {/* Word Count Filter */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Message Length</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Filter by word count per message</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={filters.wordCount.enabled}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => updateFilter('wordCount', 'enabled', v)}
        />
      </div>
    </CardHeader>
    {filters.wordCount.enabled && (
      <CardContent>
        <FormField
          control={form.control}
          name="wordCount.min"
          render={({ field }) => (
            <FormItem>
              <FormLabel>Minimum Words</FormLabel>
              <FormControl>
                <Input {...field} type="number" min={1} />
              </FormControl>
              <FormDescription>Exclude messages shorter than this</FormDescription>
              <FormMessage />
            </FormItem>
          )}
        />
      </CardContent>
    )}
  </Card>
  
  {/* Status Filter */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Resolution Status</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Filter by ticket status</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={filters.status.enabled}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => updateFilter('status', 'enabled', v)}
        />
      </div>
    </CardHeader>
    {filters.status.enabled && (
      <CardContent>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Checkbox
            checked={filters.status.resolved}
            onCheckedChange={(v) => updateFilter('status', 'resolved', v)}
          />
          <Label>Include only resolved tickets</Label>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    )}
  </Card>
  
  {/* Date Range Filter */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle className="text-lg">Date Range</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Filter by creation date</CardDescription>
        </div>
        <Switch
          checked={filters.dateRange.enabled}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => updateFilter('dateRange', 'enabled', v)}
        />
      </div>
    </CardHeader>
    {filters.dateRange.enabled && (
      <CardContent>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name="dateRange.from"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>From</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input {...field} type="date" />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name="dateRange.to"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>To</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input {...field} type="date" />
                </FormControl>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    )}
  </Card>
  
  <div className="flex justify-end">
    <Button onClick={saveFilters} disabled={isSaving || !hasChanges}>
      {isSaving ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />}
      Save Filters
    </Button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### 4.8 Processing

#### Project Processing Tab

**Route:** /projects/:id/processing  
**Roles:** member, admin  
**User Stories:** US-PROC-001, US-PROC-002, US-PROC-003

**Data Requirements:**
```typescript
const { data: processingStatus } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.processing(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/processing`),
  refetchInterval: (data) => data?.status === 'running' ? 2000 : false
});

const { data: runs } = useQuery({
  queryKey: queryKeys.projects.runs(projectId),
  queryFn: () => api.get(`/api/projects/${projectId}/runs`)
});
```

**Layout:**
```tsx
<div className="space-y-6">
  <div>
    <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">Processing</h2>
    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      Run data processing and view history
    </p>
  </div>
  
  {/* Current Processing Status */}
  {processingStatus?.status === 'running' && (
    <ProcessingProgress
      stage={processingStatus.stage}
      progress={processingStatus.progress}
      recordsProcessed={processingStatus.recordsProcessed}
      totalRecords={processingStatus.totalRecords}
    />
  )}
  
  {/* Start Processing Card */}
  {processingStatus?.status !== 'running' && (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="pt-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="font-medium">Ready to Process</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {sources.length} sources configured • {estimatedRecords.toLocaleString()} records
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button onClick={startProcessing} disabled={sources.length === 0 || isStarting}>
            {isStarting ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Play className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            )}
            Start Processing
          </Button>
        </div>
        
        {sources.length === 0 && (
          <Alert className="mt-4">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>
              Add at least one data source before processing.
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  )}
  
  {/* Processing History */}
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle className="text-lg">Processing History</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent>
      {runs.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
          No processing runs yet
        </p>
      ) : (
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Records</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Duration</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[100px]">Actions</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {runs.map(run => (
              <TableRow key={run.id}>
                <TableCell>{formatDateTime(run.createdAt)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Badge variant={
                    run.status === 'completed' ? 'default' :
                    run.status === 'failed' ? 'destructive' :
                    'secondary'
                  }>
                    {run.status}
                  </Badge>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{run.recordsProcessed.toLocaleString()}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatDuration(run.duration)}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" asChild>
                      <Link to={`/projects/${projectId}/exports?run=${run.id}`}>
                        <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Link>
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => viewReport(run.id)}>
                      <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      )}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
</div>
```

## 5. Form Specifications

### Login Form

**Location:** /login  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/auth/login

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| email | Input type="email" | Yes | Valid email format | "" |
| password | Input type="password" | Yes | Non-empty | "" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Store token in localStorage, redirect to /dashboard
- INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Toast destructive "Invalid email or password"
- RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Disable button, show countdown timer
- Other errors: Toast destructive with message

---

### Registration Form

**Location:** /register/:token  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/auth/register

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| token | hidden | Yes | From URL param | - |
| name | Input type="text" | Yes | Min 1, max 200 chars | "" |
| password | Input type="password" | Yes | Min 8 chars | "" |
| confirmPassword | Input type="password" | Yes | Must match password | "" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Store token in localStorage, redirect to /dashboard
- INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: Alert destructive, link to contact admin
- INVITATION_EXPIRED: Alert warning, link to request new
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Create Project Form

**Location:** /projects/new, Dialog  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/projects

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| name | Input type="text" | Yes | Min 1, max 200 chars | "" |
| description | Textarea | No | Max 1000 chars | "" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success, navigate to /projects/:id
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Invite User Form

**Location:** Team Settings Dialog  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/users/invite

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| email | Input type="email" | Yes | Valid email format | "" |
| role | Select | Yes | "member" or "admin" | "member" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success, refresh invitations list, close dialog
- DUPLICATE_EMAIL: Toast destructive "This email is already registered"
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Field Mapping Form

**Location:** /projects/:id/mapping  
**Endpoint:** PUT /api/projects/:id/mapping

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| conversationId | Select (source field) | Yes | Must be mapped | "" |
| content | Select (source field) | Yes | Must be mapped | "" |
| timestamp | Select (source field) | No | - | "" |
| senderRole | Select (source field) | No | - | "" |
| subject | Select (source field) | No | - | "" |
| roleField | Select (source field) | Conditional | Required if senderRole not mapped | "" |
| agentValue | Input | Conditional | Required if roleField set | "" |
| customerValue | Input | Conditional | Required if roleField set | "" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors (required fields unmapped)
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Privacy Configuration Form

**Location:** /projects/:id/privacy  
**Endpoint:** PUT /api/projects/:id/privacy

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| detectNames | Switch | No | - | true |
| detectEmails | Switch | No | - | true |
| detectPhones | Switch | No | - | true |
| detectAddresses | Switch | No | - | false |
| detectCompanies | Switch | No | - | false |
| consistentReplacement | Switch | No | - | true |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Custom Pattern Form

**Location:** Privacy Tab Dialog  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/projects/:id/privacy/rules

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| name | Input | Yes | Min 1, max 100 | "" |
| pattern | Input | Yes | Valid regex | "" |
| replacement | Input | Yes | Non-empty | "[REDACTED]" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success, refresh patterns list, close dialog
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors (invalid regex)
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

### Teamwork Connection Form

**Location:** Sources Tab Dialog  
**Endpoint:** POST /api/projects/:id/sources/api

**Fields:**

| Field | Component | Required | Validation | Default |
|-------|-----------|----------|------------|---------|
| domain | Input | Yes | Min 1 | "" |
| apiKey | Input type="password" | Yes | Min 1 | "" |
| inboxId | Select | Yes | Must be selected after connection test | "" |
| dateFrom | Input type="date" | No | - | "" |
| dateTo | Input type="date" | No | Must be after dateFrom | "" |

**Submission Handling:**
- Success: Toast success, refresh sources list, close dialog
- EXTERNAL_API_ERROR: Alert destructive with API error message
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Show field errors
- Other errors: Toast destructive

---

## 6. Error Handling

### Error Code UI Mapping

| Error Code | Component | User Message | Recovery Action |
|------------|-----------|--------------|-----------------|
| VALIDATION_ERROR | FormMessage | Field-specific message | Fix field and retry |
| INVALID_CREDENTIALS | Toast destructive | "Invalid email or password" | Re-enter credentials |
| UNAUTHORIZED | Toast + redirect | "Please log in to continue" | Redirect to /login |
| TOKEN_EXPIRED | Toast + redirect | "Your session has expired" | Redirect to /login |
| TOKEN_INVALID | Toast + redirect | "Invalid session" | Redirect to /login |
| FORBIDDEN | Alert destructive | "You don't have permission to perform this action" | Contact admin |
| ADMIN_REQUIRED | Alert destructive | "This action requires admin privileges" | Contact admin |
| NOT_FOUND | EmptyState | "Resource not found" | Back button |
| PROJECT_NOT_FOUND | Alert + redirect | "Project not found" | Redirect to /projects |
| DUPLICATE_EMAIL | Toast destructive | "This email is already registered" | Use different email |
| INVITATION_EXPIRED | Alert warning | "This invitation has expired" | Request new invitation |
| INVITATION_ALREADY_ACCEPTED | Alert info | "This invitation has already been used" | Link to login |
| PROCESSING_IN_PROGRESS | Toast warning | "Processing already in progress" | Wait for completion |
| LAST_ADMIN | Toast destructive | "Cannot remove the last admin" | Promote another admin first |
| NO_SOURCES | Alert warning | "Add at least one data source first" | Navigate to sources tab |
| RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | Toast + countdown | "Too many requests. Try again in X seconds" | Wait for timer |
| INVALID_FILE_TYPE | Toast destructive | "File type not supported. Use CSV, Excel, or JSON" | Upload different file |
| FILE_TOO_LARGE | Toast destructive | "File exceeds 50MB limit" | Upload smaller file |
| EXTERNAL_API_ERROR | Alert destructive | API-specific message | Check credentials/retry |
| INTERNAL_ERROR | Toast destructive | "Something went wrong. Please try again." | Retry button |

### Global Error Handler

```typescript
// client/src/lib/api.ts
async function handleResponse<T>(res: Response): Promise<T> {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const error = await res.json();
    
    // Handle auth errors globally
    if (error.error?.code === 'UNAUTHORIZED' || error.error?.code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') {
      localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
      window.location.href = '/login';
      throw error;
    }
    
    throw error;
  }
  return res.json();
}
```

### Rate Limit UI Pattern

```tsx
const [retryAfter, setRetryAfter] = useState<number | null>(null);

const handleSubmit = async (data: FormData) => {
  try {
    await api.post('/api/auth/login', data);
    // Success handling
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error.error?.code === 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED') {
      const resetTime = parseInt(error.error.retryAfter) || 60;
      setRetryAfter(resetTime);
      toast({
        variant: "destructive",
        title: "Too many attempts",
        description: `Please wait ${resetTime} seconds before trying again.`
      });
    }
  }
};

// Countdown effect
useEffect(() => {
  if (retryAfter && retryAfter > 0) {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setRetryAfter(retryAfter - 1), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}, [retryAfter]);

// Button with countdown
<Button type="submit" disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting || (retryAfter !== null && retryAfter > 0)}>
  {retryAfter && retryAfter > 0 ? `Wait ${retryAfter}s` : 'Sign In'}
</Button>
```

## 7. Loading & Empty States

### Loading Patterns

| Context | Pattern | Implementation |
|---------|---------|----------------|
| Page load | Full page skeleton | Skeleton matching content shape |
| Data table | Table skeleton | Skeleton rows matching columns |
| Card grid | Card skeletons | Skeleton cards in grid |
| Button action | Button spinner | Loader2 icon, button disabled |
| Form submit | Button loading state | Loader2 icon in button |
| Background refetch | No indicator | Silent refresh |
| Dialog content | Skeleton in dialog | Skeleton matching dialog content |

### Skeleton Components

```tsx
// Page skeleton
<div className="container mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">
  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Skeleton className="h-8 w-48" />
      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-72" />
    </div>
    <Skeleton className="h-10 w-32" />
  </div>
  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
    {[...Array(6)].map((_, i) => (
      <Skeleton key={i} className="h-32 rounded-lg" />
    ))}
  </div>
</div>

// Table skeleton
<Table>
  <TableHeader>
    <TableRow>
      {columns.map((_, i) => (
        <TableHead key={i}><Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" /></TableHead>
      ))}
    </TableRow>
  </TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    {[...Array(5)].map((_, i) => (
      <TableRow key={i}>
        {columns.map((_, j) => (
          <TableCell key={j}><Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" /></TableCell>
        ))}
      </TableRow>
    ))}
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

## 8. Accessibility Specifications

### Focus Management

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Dialog open | Focus first focusable element (usually close button or first input) |
| Dialog close | Return focus to trigger element |
| Form error on submit | Focus first invalid field |
| Route change | Focus h1 or main content area |
| Dropdown open | Focus first menu item |
| Dropdown close | Return focus to trigger |
| Toast appears | Announce via aria-live |

### Keyboard Navigation

| Key | Action | Context |
|-----|--------|---------|
| Tab | Move focus forward | Global |
| Shift+Tab | Move focus backward | Global |
| Enter | Submit form / Activate button | Forms, Buttons |
| Space | Toggle checkbox/switch | Checkboxes, Switches |
| Escape | Close modal/dropdown/dialog | Overlays |
| Arrow Up/Down | Navigate list items | Dropdowns, Menus |
| Home/End | Jump to first/last item | Lists |

### ARIA Requirements

| Component | ARIA Requirement |
|-----------|------------------|
| Icon-only buttons | `aria-label` describing action |
| Dialogs | `DialogTitle` (required by Radix) |
| Loading states | `aria-busy="true"` on container |
| Form errors | `aria-invalid="true"` on field, `aria-describedby` linking to error |
| Progress bars | `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` |
| Tabs | Proper tab/tabpanel roles (handled by shadcn/ui) |
| Alerts | `role="alert"` for important messages |
| Status messages | `aria-live="polite"` for non-critical updates |

### Color and Contrast

- All text must have 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
- Large text (18px+) must have 3:1 contrast ratio
- Interactive elements must have visible focus indicators
- Don't rely solely on color to convey information (use icons, text)
- Error states use both color AND icon

## 9. API Client Configuration

### API Client (client/src/lib/api.ts)

```typescript
// CRITICAL: Base URL is always empty (relative)
// - Development: Vite proxy handles /api/* → Express on 3001
// - Production: Same origin, Express serves both static and API
const API_BASE = '';

interface ApiError {
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
    details?: Array<{ field: string; message: string }>;
  };
}

function getAuthHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
  return token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {};
}

async function handleResponse<T>(res: Response): Promise<T> {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const error: ApiError = await res.json();
    
    // Global auth error handling
    if (error.error?.code === 'UNAUTHORIZED' || 
        error.error?.code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED' ||
        error.error?.code === 'TOKEN_INVALID') {
      localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
      if (!window.location.pathname.startsWith('/login')) {
        window.location.href = '/login';
      }
    }
    
    throw error;
  }
  
  return res.json();
}

export const api = {
  async get<T>(endpoint: string): Promise<T> {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },

  async post<T>(endpoint: string, data?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },

  async put<T>(endpoint: string, data?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { ...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },

  async patch<T>(endpoint: string, data?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      headers: { ...getAuthHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined,
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },

  async delete<T>(endpoint: string): Promise<T> {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(),
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },

  async upload<T>(endpoint: string, file: File, additionalData?: Record<string, string>): Promise<T> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file);
    if (additionalData) {
      Object.entries(additionalData).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        formData.append(key, value);
      });
    }
    
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${endpoint}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: getAuthHeaders(), // Don't set Content-Type for FormData
      body: formData,
    });
    return handleResponse<T>(res);
  },
};
```

## Downstream Handoff Brief

### For Agent 6: Implementation Orchestrator

**Component Installation:**
```bash
npx shadcn-ui@latest init
npx shadcn-ui@latest add button card dialog form input label select toast alert alert-dialog dropdown-menu avatar badge skeleton tabs table progress switch checkbox textarea separator sheet command popover tooltip
```

**Peer Dependencies:**
```bash
npm install @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog @radix-ui/react-dialog @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu @radix-ui/react-label @radix-ui/react-select @radix-ui/react-slot @radix-ui/react-tabs @radix-ui/react-toast @radix-ui/react-progress @radix-ui/react-switch @radix-ui/react-checkbox @radix-ui/react-popover @radix-ui/react-tooltip
npm install lucide-react class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge
npm install react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod
npm install @tanstack/react-query
npm install react-dropzone
```

**Critical Configuration:**
- client/src/index.css must use Tailwind v4 `@import "tailwindcss"` syntax
- client/src/index.css must include light/dark mode CSS variables
- client/src/lib/utils.ts must have cn() function
- API client must use relative URLs (empty base)
- Auth token stored in localStorage as `auth_token`

**Error Handling Requirements:**
- Global API interceptor for auth errors (401 → redirect to /login)
- Toast component for all feedback
- Rate limit countdown UI for auth endpoints

**Implementation Order:**
1. Design system (CSS variables, Tailwind config)
2. Auth screens (login, register, forgot/reset password)
3. Layout components (sidebar, nav, user menu)
4. Dashboard
5. Projects (list, create, detail)
6. Sources (file upload, API connection)
7. Configuration (mapping, privacy, filters)
8. Processing and exports
9. Settings (profile, team)
10. Activity log
